Always begin on a bright note.
Expressive from every angle, the 2021 Lincoln Corsair combines spirited agility with responsive adaptability for an exciting
ride. Each time you approach, Corsair greets you with a warm embrace. Lincoln Signature Lighting glows beneath the LED
headlamps, while illuminated welcome mats and backlit door handles extend an invitation. Within the airy 5-passenger
interior, luxurious amenities and serene quietness await. You’ll also enjoy unique elements like an available illuminated
Lincoln Star logo shining down on the center console, and beautiful chimes orchestrated by a world-renowned symphony.
Chart an exhilarating course for your future in Corsair.

SPARK YOUR SOPHISTICATED SIDE
When innovation sits at the table of luxury, astonishing things will happen. Introducing the Lincoln Corsair
Grand Touring plug-in hybrid.1 Agile but smooth. Sporty but elegant. Powerful but graceful. This is a hybrid
in more ways than one. Corsair Grand Touring seamlessly blends an advanced hybrid powertrain with an
impressively vigorous electric motor to offer you effortless acceleration, electric AWD, and a peaceful cabin.
Go ahead, make a grand escape.
THRIVE WITH LINCOLN DRIVE MODES
Corsair puts the power to adapt right at your
fingertips. Simply turn the knob to choose
a Lincoln Drive Mode, and the system
adjusts traction control, steering and pedal
response, available Intelligent AWD and
available adaptive suspension settings, even
the sound of the engine, to help provide a
remarkable driving experience.
Grand Touring models also feature additional
drive modes. “Preserve EV” mode can
help recharge the vehicle up to as much as
75% by saving battery power for later use.
“Pure EV” mode offers a quiet, all-electric
drive well-suited to your shorter trips around
town. That’s two intelligent modes, for one
extraordinary drive.
1 Available Winter 2020–2021. Available only at EV-certified Lincoln Dealers.

ENRICH YOUR TRAVELS
Whether you’re making the most of some alone time or sharing a journey with friends,
Corsair offers the functionality and flexibility you need to optimize every experience. An
available panoramic Vista Roof® with power sunshade lets you increase the spacious
feeling inside the cabin at the push of a button. Available heated rear outboard seats help
keep passengers cozy, no matter the forecast. And when the need arises, you can slide
the rear seats forward 6" to take advantage of up to 34.0 cu. ft. of rear cargo space.1 That’s
enough room to carry 4 large suitcases,2 while still seating 4 of your friends. To fold the
rear seat backs down, just press the available EasyFold® release buttons and you’ll have
up to 57.6 cu. ft. of space1 to fill. Corsair even offers you effortless access to the cargo area,
raising its available hands-free liftgate with just a kick of your foot beneath the rear bumper.
Available Lincoln Accessories wheel shown. 134.0 cu. ft. of max. cargo volume behind rear seats on Corsair trim; 33.2 on Reserve and Grand Touring. 57.6 cu. ft. of max.
